title: Features with few carriers
description: This check finds exception features that fewer than four entries carry on stem MSAs, yet that an affix MSA requires or a phonological rule uses. An exception feature restricts an affix or rule to the stems that carry it. When only one to three stems carry it, the restriction lists words instead of describing a productive pattern. A feature with no carrier at all, and no affix or rule that uses it, is left to unused-statement reporting.
